title: Consistent Noisy Single-Index Regression
exact_claim: Modify curved nonlinear single-index regression to be consistent for fixed nonzero response noise despite nonshrinking latent support of raw response slices.
scope_resolution: Conditional literal noisy consistency established for arbitrary Borel designs with bounded continuous F and conditionally centered uniformly finite-variance noise at fixed D. Full underspecified original-model coverage not established; dimension-efficient geometry is a separate unproved objective.
success_test: Prove literal noisy mean-square consistency under an explicit model, then verify whether the source intends that complete model; do not add an unstated dimension-efficient-rate requirement.
independent_review: Original packet audited with scoped corrections; exact auxiliary theorem independently accepted. Corrected v2 assembly awaits binding review.
status_reason: Source-model coverage remains unverified; the explicit bounded-model consistency theorem is affirmative.
supersedes: Original scope/readiness assessment only; historical evidence and original files preserved.
